body.label: Target
body.html: Self; an exposed patch of loose earth within 1 unit.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Move through up to 2 units of loose, unworked earth and emerge in a detected empty space. This leaves no usable tunnel and cannot pass through foundations or stone.

surges.html: On emerging, suppress one ordinary restraint on yourself until your next turn.

rider.title: Adaptation - Strider
rider.html: Assume Burrowing Palms (upkeep 0): loose earth and rubble do not count as difficult terrain for your normal Movement.
